transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer accounts, my name is Naomi. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Naomi. I'm calling because I'm relocating to Spain next month for work, so I need to close my broadband account and arrange to send my router back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly guide you through closing your account and getting equipment return packaging dispatched, Mia. I hope the relocation to Spain goes smoothly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Naomi. It's quite a stressful move so I want to make sure the utilities are sorted in advance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we access your cancellation records, Mia, could you please verify your full UK installation address and your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 47 Stretford Road, Manchester, M16 0FG, and my security PIN is 8421.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for verifying those details, Mia. I have your Gigafast 300 account open on my screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to confirm what you are looking to do: you are relocating abroad to Spain on the twentieth of next month, so you would like to schedule the cancellation of your broadband service and receive a prepaid returns bag for your router. Have I understood correctly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, spot on. The moving vans arrive on the twentieth, so having the internet shut off on the twentieth would be ideal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the contract dates on your profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I believe my eighteen-month minimum term finished in January.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Looking at your contract start date... yes, you completed your minimum term in January and you are on a standard rolling 30-day agreement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That means there are no early termination fees, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Because you are out of contract, there are zero early cancellation penalties.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's wonderful news.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will schedule the service cessation for midnight on the twentieth of next month so you have full internet connectivity right up to your moving day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be perfect so I can still work from home while packing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let me check the equipment return rules for your S-Net Hub 4 router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you still there, Naomi?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am right here Mia, apologies for the pause while the equipment return database was updating.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's okay, I wasn't sure if the call had dropped.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under our environmental policy, all S-Net Hub 4 and Hub 5 routers must be returned for refurbishment or recycling within thirty days of cancellation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do you send out a prepaid return bag, or do I have to pay postage?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We send out a padded prepaid Royal Mail returns bag free of charge, with a tracked return label already attached.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send the bag to my current address this week so I can pack the router as soon as the line switches off?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can dispatch the return bag immediately. It will arrive via standard post within three to five business days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What accessories need to go in the bag along with the router?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please include the main black Hub router, its power supply adapter, and the gray broadband cable.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what about the yellow Ethernet cable?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are welcome to keep the yellow Ethernet cable or pop it in the bag as well.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What should I do with the telephone wall socket adapter and the broadband microfilters?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Those small plastic adapters do not need to be returned; you are welcome to dispose of them in household recycling or keep them for the incoming tenant.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's convenient, less clutter to pack into moving boxes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And if the next tenant moves in and needs broadband, they can activate service on the existing master socket without an engineer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will make it very easy for the landlord and the incoming renters.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once you hand the parcel over at any local Post Office, make sure to retain the proof of posting receipt for your records.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the receipt have the Royal Mail tracking barcode?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the barcode links directly to our returns warehouse inventory system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's very reassuring so I don't get charged for unreturned equipment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If equipment is not received within thirty days, our automated system generates an unreturned equipment fee of sixty-five pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And the tracking receipt protects against that if Royal Mail takes time to deliver it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, entering the tracking barcode onto your online account immediately exempts you from any equipment charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me total protection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me finalize the postal dispatch order on the packaging fulfillment system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you still looking at the postal order on your screen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, still here Mia, the packaging order has just successfully submitted.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The prepaid packaging order confirmation number is RTN-582910.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Got that written down, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And your final bill will be calculated on a pro-rata basis up to the twentieth, with any credit balance refunded to your direct debit within fourteen days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will my direct debit stay open until the final refund is processed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please leave the direct debit instruction active on your UK bank account so our automated system can process your final refund.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. I will keep my UK bank account open until the refund clears.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about the direct debit mandate? Does it cancel itself after the final refund or should I cancel it at the bank?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the credit balance is refunded to your account on the next billing date, our automated billing engine automatically issues an electronic cancellation instruction to BACS.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So I don't need to do anything manually on my online banking app?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. The mandate will close cleanly without any action on your part.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's one less administrative task to worry about while preparing for an international move.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you also checked if you have any active email accounts or cloud storage backups linked to your S-Net broadband login?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I only use Google Drive and Gmail for all my personal files and emails.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's great, because third-party cloud storage is completely unaffected by home broadband cancellation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very reassuring so none of my documents get locked out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What email address should we send your final zero-balance statement to once the account is closed?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please send it to mia.taylor@gmail.com so I have proof of account closure for my records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have updated your primary contact email to ensure you receive your final PDF invoice abroad.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I still access my online account portal after the twentieth to download past bills for tax purposes?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your My S-Net portal login will remain active in view-only mode for ninety days after account termination.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very helpful for my end-of-year tax filing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A full cancellation confirmation letter and final billing schedule will be emailed to you today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Naomi, thank you so much for handling my cancellation so smoothly. It takes a huge worry off my shoulders for the move.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure assisting you, Mia. Best of luck with your relocation and your new chapter in Spain.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Naomi, take care!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Mia. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye!
